description: THE TRAILING SPACE THAT JUST RIGHT ACTUALLY MOVES, AND THE TRANSFER THAT NEVER RETURNS. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY dispatching the two-byte option image '1 ' - the digit one then a space - for an administrator: CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'A' arrives in the communication area with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT already 1, so app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:87 takes the ELSE, line 92 receives the map, and the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER - gate G30. WHAT THIS CASE EXISTS FOR is the SCAN-RUNS-DOWN-TO-BYTE-ONE arm of the four-step normalisation at 117-125, and it is the ONLY fixture in this folder in which the JUST RIGHT clause does real work. OPTIONI is PIC X(2) (app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132), so LENGTH OF OPTIONI is 2 and the descending test-before scan at 117-121 tests OPTIONI(2:1) FIRST: byte two holds a space, so the first UNTIL term is false, and WS-IDX is still 2 so the second term is false as well - the loop DECREMENTS to 1 and only then leaves, on the WS-IDX = 1 term rather than on a non-space byte. Line 122 therefore moves ONE byte and not two into WS-OPTION-X PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT (line 45), and a short sender into a JUSTIFIED RIGHT receiver lands at the receiver's RIGHTMOST position with the vacated byte space-filled on the LEFT, so WS-OPTION-X becomes ' 1'. app/bms/COMEN01.bms:145-149 declares the same direction independently: OPTION DFHMDF ATTRB=(FSET,IC,NORM,NUM,UNPROT) HILIGHT=UNDERLINE JUSTIFY=(RIGHT,ZERO) LENGTH=2. Line 123, INSPECT WS-OPTION-X REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0', then turns that vacated LEADING byte into a zero and yields '01'; line 124 carries the image across into WS-OPTION PIC 9(02) (line 46) at equal widths, so WS-OPTION is 01; and line 125 echoes the NORMALISED '01' rather than the '1 ' the operator typed. THE FAILURE MODE THIS CATCHES, and the whole reason the fixture exists, is a translation that trims the field or that left-justifies the MOVE: either reading leaves '1 ' in the receiver, INSPECT then replaces the TRAILING space instead of a leading one, WS-OPTION becomes 10, and the transfer goes to COBIL00C - option 10, 'Bill Payment' at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:80-84 - instead of COACTVWC. Nothing else in this folder separates those two readings, because at equal widths JUST RIGHT is inert and a trimming implementation passes unnoticed. THE PAIR: case06 drives the mirror image ' 1', where byte two is NOT a space, the scan stops at 2, BOTH bytes cross into an equal-width receiver, and INSPECT alone produces '01'. The two images reach WS-OPTION 01 by structurally different routes and must therefore produce the IDENTICAL fingerprint, so every member below except the inbound OPTIONI is deliberately byte-identical to case06's - that identity IS the assertion, and a difference anywhere else between the two files would mean one of them is wrong. The three-term guard at 127-129 is false on every term: 01 holds digits, 01 is not greater than the CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT of 10 (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21), and 01 is not zero - so no 'Please enter a valid option number...' is composed and WS-ERR-FLG stays as line 77 set it. The ungated filter at 136-137 still evaluates and is settled by its FIRST conjunct alone: 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:28) is false for 'A', so no 'No access - Admin Only option... ' either. Line 145 finds the flag OFF, line 146 finds COACTVWC's leading five bytes to be 'COACT' and not 'DUMMY', and lines 147, 148 and 151 set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to 'CM00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to 'COMEN01C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back to 0 before the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area to CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION), which app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:28 values COACTVWC - gate G40, and the 1-based FIRST slot of CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 at :88, which is the lower half of gate G33. Lines 149 and 150 are COMMENTED OUT, so CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE cross unchanged, and nothing on this path writes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM - only the PF3 arm at 97 and the signon default at 173 do. THE FALL-THROUGH TRAP is the second decisive assertion: an EXEC CICS XCTL never returns, so 157-164 do not execute and neither the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at 158 nor the STRING at 159-163 happens - that STRING would have run the words together as This option Accountis coming soon ... with NO space before is, because CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(1) is DELIMITED BY SPACE and stops at the first space of the thirty-five-byte 'Account View' literal while the suffix carries no leading space. That image is asserted ABSENT: expectedMessages carries WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) of line 38 - the eighty-byte working-storage field, and NOT the seventy-eight-byte ERRMSGO PIC X(78) of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:138 that line 187 truncates it into - exactly as the SPACES of line 79 left it, so a translation that fell out of the transfer fails on the message, and a seventy-eight-byte expectation would fail the channel's own width check before it ever reached the differ. The block stays preserved dead code, neither wired up nor removed. THREE CONTRACT FACTS are stated deliberately rather than left to omission. First, NO mapset and NO map is named. The brief for this fixture asked for COMEN1A and COMEN01, and that is recorded here rather than silently followed, because MAP('COMEN1A') and MAPSET('COMEN01') at 190-191 sit inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN, which a transfer never performs: naming them would tell the client to paint the screen the program is leaving, the translation reports both as blank on a transfer, and the differ compares them as absent on each side - so declaring either would manufacture a difference against correct behaviour. Second, sends is empty for the same reason, so the '01' echo cannot travel in a payload and is re-derived from the raw '1 ' and asserted by the service adapter instead. Third, the pinned clock lives in screenRequest.pinnedClock - 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the version footer of app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl and the one instant all twenty cases in this folder share - because ParityCase admits jobParameters only for a BATCH_JOB; nothing on this path reads a clock anyway, since FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at line 214 sits in POPULATE-HEADER-INFO, which only SEND-MENU-SCREEN performs. COMEN01C copies no CSSETATY, whose sole consumer is app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl, so no DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight appears anywhere in this folder and gate G38 is honoured through the ENTER/REENTER split: this is a REENTER-side case that nonetheless emits no error output, and ERRMSGC keeps the mapset's declared COLOR=RED because line 158 is unreached. The whole conversation travels in the payload, with no server-side forward and no session state - gate G37. CDEMO-USER-TYPE is trusted exactly as it arrives and is never re-read from USRSEC, re-verified or hashed, because line 150 is commented out and the single X(01) comparison at 137 is the entire authorisation mechanism. The unit is admin.MainMenuService driven directly, with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher - gate G51; inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because COMEN01C declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file verb; expectedReturnCode is 0 because an online transaction sets none. This re-derivation replaces an earlier case07 that drove the non-digit image '1x' at the NOT NUMERIC term of line 127. That drive is NOT lost and was checked before this file was rewritten: COMEN01CParityTest.theOptionNormalisationReproducesAllFourSteps carries the row 1x/2/1x/1x/not-numeric asserting the class test at line 127, and MainMenuServiceTest drives the same image at its term-1 case, at aNonDigitIsReportedAsNotNumeric and at the no-usable-subscript filter case; the 'Please enter a valid option number...' image it used to pin at fixture level is still pinned by case08's out-of-range 11 and case09's far-out-of-range 99. Every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybooks and the BMS definitions and was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution - no such runtime exists in this environment, per the eight verified blockers recorded in 0.7.6 of the plan (risk R-A). No user rules are provided for this project - review_rules returns exactly that - so the plan's enterprise practices govern instead: B1, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8, B11 and B12. Gates pinned: G15, G18, G30, G33, G37, G40 and G51.
